informal_statement:
For a regular type-\(\mathrm{iii}\) assembly with density \(\lambda>1\), curvature \(0<h<1\), and coordinate carrier \(E_3\), the weighted area is the ambient Lebesgue integral

\[
A_\lambda(E_3)=\int_{E_3} f_\lambda\,d\mathcal L^2.
\]
